text: Nasdaq-100 futures fell about 2.2% and S&P 500 futures about 1% before the open, with Intel down about 25% and Amazon about 7% after their results.
Gold slipped below $4,000, down about 1.4% to near $3,964, with traders still betting on a December Fed hike.
Silver fell about 4% to near $50, so the gold/silver ratio rose to about 79 from 77.
GDX was down about 3.2% before the open at $78.77, roughly twice gold's drop.
The 10-year yield eased about 3 bp to 4.91%, its lowest in seven weeks.
Brent rose about 1% to near $116 after Houthi attacks on Saudi oil sites.
Bitcoin fell to about $77,400, down about 3.6% since Thursday's US close, after a reported Binance hack.
The yen firmed for a third session to about 157.4 per dollar after the Bank of Japan held rates, and the dollar index eased to 101.67.
